unit.why: A short anecdote: the tsaddik's mother sees a tsaddik's soul during prayer and correctly infers that it is his yahrzeit, which the people then verify.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series of anecdotes about the tsaddik's mother (previous §: his birth foretold; next §: her vision during Kedushah); this section stands as its own episode.

stories.start_quote: ובל תחשוב כי היא וחלומותיה היו
stories.end_quote: והבינה כי היום הוא היא״צ שלו
stories.summary_en: The mother of the tsaddik, a woman of high spiritual rank who saw souls of tzaddikim while awake, asks one morning after prayer whether it is a certain tzaddik's yahrzeit; inquiry confirms it, and she explains she saw him during prayer.

tags.why: The mother is the central actor and visionary.

quotes: באשר שמעתי בפירוש ממרן הק זצ״ל
tags.why: The protagonist is the tsaddik's mother.
She sees a departed tzaddik's soul while awake.
Souls of tzaddikim are disclosed to her.

quotes: שאלה מהאנשים אם היום הוא היא״צ של צדיק פלוני
tags.why: Through her vision she knows the yahrzeit, which she could not have known otherwise.
The text calls it a disclosure (giluy) of souls.
The vision occurs during morning prayer.

quotes: תדע כי נודע ומפורסם שהיתה בעל מדרגה גדולה
tags.why: The story praises her spiritual rank.

missing_concepts: verification of a supernatural claim by inquiry
spiritual rank of a tsaddik's mother
